title: bug: cachedPlanPaths.git.test.ts 'resolves a plain repository' fails on native Windows (git prints C:/ forward slashes, test expects realpath backslashes)
description: Native Windows (Git Bash, node 24.16, `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test`) on HEAD 856bfac: 1 failed | 5182 passed. src/util/cachedPlanPaths.git.test.ts:28 expects `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` to equal fs.realpathSync(tmp) = 'C:\Users\…\moe-cfg-XXXX', but Git prints 'C:/Users/…/moe-cfg-XXXX'. Added by 5f497451 (task-0b9db30f, DONE, Linux-only verification). Likely a test-side fix: compare path.resolve() of both sides, or normalize separators.
definitionOfDone: cachedPlanPaths.git.test.ts passes on native Windows and on Linux
No change to openProjectGit behaviour unless the code itself is shown to be wrong

implementationPlan.description:
Gate, then the one-assertion fix in packages/moe-daemon/src/util/cachedPlanPaths.git.test.ts.

Gate: from /mnt/d/projexts/moes, `git status --porcelain -- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/cachedPlanPaths.git.test.ts` must print nothing. The file was clean on 2026-10-30. If it is dirty, call moe.get_commit_scope { taskId: 'task-b64659ca3ddf4f629975f9f472c24c3c' }:
- if peers declare the path, report_blocked on those task ids;
- otherwise report_blocked with no ids, naming the path.
Never revert or commit other sessions' bytes.

Root cause, reproduced on native Windows from WSL on 2026-10-30: 'Expected: "C:\Users\Yaron\AppData\Local\Temp\moe-cfg-TBk0kA" / Received: "C:/Users/Yaron/AppData/Local/Temp/moe-cfg-TBk0kA"'. Git for Windows prints forward slashes, while the fixture's fs.realpathSync gives backslashes.
The code under test is right. openProjectGit (src/util/cachedPlanPaths.ts:128-131) already compares pathKey(realpath(top)) with pathKey(root). Per the DoD, do NOT touch cachedPlanPaths.ts.

In the first `it` ('resolves a plain repository and runs Git through the returned runner'), replace
`expect((await git('rev-parse --show-toplevel', ['rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'])).trim()).toBe(root);`
with
```ts
    const top = (await git('rev-parse --show-toplevel', ['rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'])).trim();
    // Git for Windows prints C:/..., realpathSync C:\...: compare the directory each names.
    expect(fs.realpathSync.native(top)).toBe(fs.realpathSync.native(root));
```
Why native on both sides: the OS canonical form expands 8.3 short names (for example a CI runner's C:\Users\RUNNER~1\...) and true case, not only the separators. On Linux it is plain realpath(3), so the assertion is unchanged there.
The test still fails if the runner ran Git anywhere but the project root. An empty or missing `top` throws ENOENT, so error handling stays fail-loud.
Change nothing else: the other five tests and the fixture stay byte-identical.
implementationPlan.note: Gate clean. One assertion replaced with realpathSync.native on both sides.
